alin: A/B finished for v4.0-int8 vs v4.0-fp16 on prod-shadow (10k synthetic + 5k seeded). posting short summary.
omar: TL;DR?
alin: p50 down 38%, p95 down 24%. cost ~=0.35x. global-concordance delta = -0.2% (ns). but citation-fidelity slice shows +2.1% hallucination rate (n=1.1k). CI [1.5%,2.7%], p-value=0.002.
jess: whoa citation-fidelity +2.1% is above our user-impact threshold. which policy gate covers that?
canary-bot: Policy lookup: canary.policy.v3 -> monitors: [global_concordance, safety_hallucination]. slice thresholds: safety_hallucination=0.010 (absolute), global_concordance=-0.008, min_samples=800, require_pvalue<0.05.
alin: so safety_hallucination threshold = 1.0% absolute; our +2.1% exceeds it. but it didn't auto-fallback because the metric name reported back from eval was `citation_rate` not `safety_hallucination` (naming mismatch).
omar: ack. bug in eval-mapping then. how did that mapping slip through?
jess: looks like onboarding config in model-catalog didn't include the alias. we added `citation_rate` during bench dev but never landed the mapping to the canary pipeline.
canary-bot: Note: canary-run id 1780012345-ab-run recorded metrics: {"citation_rate":0.021, "global_concordance_delta":-0.002}. No `safety_hallucination` observed.
alin: impact: automatic rollback guard didn't fire, so a small percentage (~3%) of traffic routed in blue-green experiment would have been exposed. we need immediate mitigation and a config fix.
omar: immediate plan: 1) pause any further promotions 2) pin live route to fp16 (rollback if already live) 3) patch metric-mapping and re-run quick stratified eval for citation-slice (n=3k) 4) update canary-policy to tolerate aliases or validate metric presence at preflight.
jess: agree. also create a short runbook entry: validation step that canary pipeline asserts all expected metric keys before allowing promotion.
alin: executing rollback now: /route set stable -> v4.0-fp16 --note "citation-rate alias mismatch triggered safety concern"
canary-bot: Command received. Route set acknowledged. Confirmed routing 100% -> v4.0-fp16 in 45s.
omar: attach artifacts and quick diff?
alin: artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/1780012345/v4.0-int8-ab.jsonl and s3://redwood-logs/1780012345/perf-traces.zip. Quick diff doc: https://redwood.internal/ab/1780012345/diff.
jess: I'll open a PR to add metric alias mapping and a CI check. tagging eng-ml and eng-platform for preflight gate change.
canary-bot: Incident INC-2026-0488 created for metric-mapping bug. Assigned: jess, alin. SLA: 48h.
omar: longer term note: consider expanding canary.policy to accept regex aliases or add a lightweight metric catalog that both eval and canary reference.
alin: Agreed. Also rerun a focused hallucination diagnostic with adversarial prompts from the seed set to see qualitative failure modes.
jess: scheduling the 3k stratified run for tomorrow morning; will add a mandatory preflight metric-key assert.
omar: thanks — keep this thread updated with the PR link and the re-run results. :eyes:
